label: Late in the episode, D2 arrival at S1 after choosing a2, strongest when coming from S2.
terms: (in_action == 2) * (in_state == 1) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 70, 0) ;; (in_state > 0) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 70, 0) ;; (in_action == 2) * (in_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 70, 0) ;; (in_action == 2) * (in_state == 1) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * np.maximum(ep_trial - 70, 0) ;; (in_action == 2) * (in_state == 1) * (prev_state == 2) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 70, 0) ;; (in_action == 2) * (in_state == 1) * belief_lo * np.maximum(ep_trial - 70, 0)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only in the last ~30 trials of the episode. Its size grows roughly linearly with ep_trial past ~70, on rare a2 -> S1 arrivals (observed at D2 as in_action = 2 and in_state = 1). Arriving at S1 when the previous trial reached S2 adds a lot; other D2 arrivals sit below the D2 timing mean (the negative third term). The free fit (dev 0.81 vs short 0.705) adds that a2 -> S1 fires more when the previous trial was rewarded and less after a2 S1 unrewarded, so it is suppressed on repeated a2 -> S1 trials. The belief log-odds adds nothing. Nothing happens at D1/GO. All terms are observed at D2.

issues: The recorded short form leaves out the previous trial's reward, and that causes a systematic error. In a free fit with one weight per previous trial for late a2->S1 arrivals (test 0.646), the weight after an unrewarded S1 trial is about zero (a2 S1 u -0.010, a1 S1 u -0.006). After a rewarded S1 trial it is about 0.03, after S2 unrewarded 0.037-0.048, and after S2 rewarded 0.056-0.061. So the feature is about silent when the previous trial was S1 unrewarded. It fires after S1 rewarded, more after S2, and most after S2 rewarded.

Misses on the recorded short form confirm this. The largest over-predictions are at D2 after a2 S1 u (-0.043), a1 S2 u (-0.033) and a2 S2 u (-0.028). The worst-fit windows are repeated a2->S1 arrivals after an unrewarded S1 trial: actual 0, predicted about 0.9-1.1.
The label says it is 'strongest when coming from S2' but says nothing about reward. A reader would predict firing after a2 S1 u, where it actually stays near zero.

The term (in_state==1)*(prev_state==2) is not limited to a2 choices. a1->S1 arrivals barely fire whatever the previous trial: an all-a1 fit gives test 0.012 beyond timing, with weights of 0.017 or less.
The ramp starting at trial 70 was a fitted choice. Starting it at 75 scores better: the recorded terms reach 0.715 and the revised terms 0.795 on test.

Checks that held up: the feature fires only at D2 (timing is zero at D1 and GO), only late in the episode, and on a2->S1 rare arrivals (this choice x state code 7 has residual +0.166). Belief adds little. The negative third term is a reasonable correction to the baseline, not curve fitting.
